name: nlams-monorepo
description: SIH26016 - National Land Acquisition & Management System (NLAMS) Monorepo

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: node init && cd server && npm run dev
scripts.dev:client: node init && cd client && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build:client: node init && cd client && npm run build
scripts.build:server: node init && cd server && npm run build
scripts.start: node init && cd server && npm start

author: SIH Team
